choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The hour will not be hidden from.
[TODO:ru] You step into the torchlight.
[TODO:ru] Not by power, but by surrender.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You rise to meet them.

angels_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Heaven could rescue you in a breath.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You set your face like flint.

His lantern trembles in his hand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Meet betrayal with grace.
[TODO:ru] Stay. The cup is here.
[TODO:ru] Your voice is soft, unbroken.

shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Even now, love is your answer.
Let him hear it once more.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His eyes break under your gaze.

run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] You did not pray all night to flee.
Meet him where you stand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You hold your ground in peace.

kiss.text:
[TODO:ru] Judas leans close. "Rabbi."
His lips brush your cheek in betrayal.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] No violence answers this kiss.
[TODO:ru] "Do what you came to do."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Pretend you do not know him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Truth, even now. Especially now.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not by the Sword
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Even Judas is loved to the end.
Let the kiss become his witness.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your stillness is louder than wrath.

pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Denial is not your way.
Meet him face to face.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You stand fully revealed.

[TODO:ru] The guards halt at the edge of the light.
Their eyes search the disciples.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let the disciples be taken too
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Shield them. The hour is yours alone.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand silent and let them guess
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Speak. Name yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."

You drink this cup alone.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The guards step back at your voice.

Declare who you are.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The crowd staggers and falls back.

peter_sword.text:
[TODO:ru] Peter lifts a sword above his head.
It flashes toward the high priest's servant.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] This is not the kingdom's way.
[TODO:ru] Peter freezes, sword still raised.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take the sword and fight beside him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The kingdom is not won by blades.

cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Those who live by the sword die by it.
Speak the harder word.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Peter lowers the blade trembling.

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Cup, Not the Sword
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The Father's plan needs no defenders.
It needs a willing Son.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your calm halts the night.

heal_ear.title: [TODO:ru] No More of This
heal_ear.text:

Fear and pain shake his whole frame.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Walk past him to be arrested

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Curse the men who came for you

belongs to your enemy.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] He looks up at you, stunned.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The grove falls silent in awe.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let them go without a word

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The path is yours to walk.
